g.text: The first rule that applies decides the score
saves any posted data, then merges every save,
oldest first; partial scoring is off when
every model in the item turns it off
records it on the session; a score request
gets it back, rescaled when env.maxPoints > 1
A manual score at or after the latest response
An auto score recorded for the latest response
with the same partialScoring, unless skipCached is set
config.rubric, or a model whose element is a rubric
for each model the session has data for,
its score, out of its max (1 if unset)
the mean of score ÷ max, out of 1
